judge_input.description: ## Hey, I just made a Pull Request! Closses: - #32429 `ScheduledTasksContent` now gives visual feedback when a user lacks permission to trigger a scheduled task: a new `CreateNotAllowed` component shows a disabled block icon with a descriptive tooltip, used as `RequirePermission`'s `errorPage` prop. Additional changes: - Centered the tasks table's Actions column for UI alignment. - Changeset for the patch release. #### :heavy_check_mark: Checklist - [x] Changeset describing the change and affected packages. ([more info](https://github.com/backstage/backstage/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#creating-changesets)) - [ ] Documentation added/updated - [x] Tests for new functionality and bug-fix regressions - [x] Screenshots attached - [x] Commits carry `Signed-off-by`. ([more info](https://github.com/backstage/backstage/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin))
judge_input.title: fix(devtools): improve permission feedback in ScheduledTasksContent
